name: university-erp-root
description: Root workspace configuration for University ERP Monorepo

scripts.docker:fresh: dotenvx run -f .env -- docker compose build --no-cache frontend-builder && dotenvx run -f .env -- docker compose build --no-cache api worker migrator
scripts.docker:restart: npm run docker:restart-backend && npm run docker:restart-frontend
scripts.docker:restart-backend: dotenvx run -f .env -- docker compose restart api worker migrator
scripts.docker:restart-frontend: dotenvx run -f .env -- docker compose restart frontend-builder
scripts.docker:restart-nginx: dotenvx run -f .env -- docker compose restart nginx
